text:
Came across a video promoting this app from the app creator, told them I couldn’t find it in the App Store, instead of just sending the link straight away, to a new user, they gave me homework and told me to go back to the App Store and scroll down further (I had already scrolled down like 8 pages of apps, nowhere to be seen). Used to work in tech for a long time & built many apps. Might be good practice if someone says they can’t find you, to believe them, and share the link to gain that customer instead of making them do more work for something they want to try. More barriers to entry = less conversions. Also, being inclusive and having good customer service practices is a great way to gain loyal customers. 

I will not be one. I downloaded the app after they finally sent the link and it’s not what it’s promoting itself to be and even further confirmed by the other reviews 

Also, after downloading, the welcome screen says it’s targeted for european market first. Mind you I am not in Europe. This might be an important thing to mention on your instagram or in your promotional videos. Idk if this is their first time building an app but these are all ways to not only, not get conversions but it’s a sure fire way to get people to not trust you and dislike your product and not want to engage again. 

I was excited for this app but now I will not be supporting them. May not be worth much to them to hear my thoughts but maybe other users can gain from my experience

Anyway, that’s my review. 🤍 I’m going to review their terms now to make sure they are safe for their users and not doing any other shady practices. i encourage others to do the same.
